header: Four partners and what each one approves
lead: Aubruck has been a partnership since 2016. If a job goes wrong, one of these four partners calls you personally.

people.title: Marlene Ostermann
people.text: Joined in 1998 as a surveying technician and took over from Gerhard Tulln in 2016. Signs every fee proposal above €40,000.

people.title: Andrea Brandstätter
people.text: Leads boundary surveys and looks after the district's fixed survey points. After 21 years of boundary work here, the land registry usually calls Andrea first.

people.title: Tobias Reindl
people.text: Leads road and drainage design and site supervision. Joined in 2009 after years with a civil engineering contractor.

people.title: Katja Sunder
people.text: Handles contracts, invoicing, insurance and apprenticeships. Non-technical questions go to Katja and are usually answered the same day.
